name: Ambient Temperature
description: Atmospheric kinetic temperature driving enzyme activity, evapotranspiration rates, and thermal growth units (Growing Degree Days).
importance: Controls biological phenology, including seed germination kinetics, canopy photosynthesis velocity, pollen viability during anthesis, and post-flowering grain filling.

thermal_stress_ranges.chilling_frost: < 10°C (frost damage, flower drop, disruption of vascular sap flow in tropical crops)
thermal_stress_ranges.tropical_optimal: 24°C - 34°C (ideal for rice, maize, cotton, banana, sugarcane)
thermal_stress_ranges.heat_stress: > 36°C (pollen sterility, stomatal closure, premature desiccation, respiration exceeding photosynthesis)

mitigation_strategies: Select heat-tolerant or short-duration cultivars if high temperatures coincide with critical flowering phases.
Adopt micro-irrigation (sprinklers) during peak diurnal heat to provide evaporative microclimate cooling.
Utilize organic straw mulching to buffer soil root-zone temperatures.
